# Cannot compute: country of production is missing

Under the ruleset, the default SEE is selected jointly by **CN code and country of production**, and all three inputs are required:

| Required input | Provided? |
|---|---|
| (a) CN code in table | ✅ 7201 (pig iron) |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | ❌ **Not provided** |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | ✅ 1,000 t |

CN 7201 has three different default values depending on country, so no single SEE can be selected. The ruleset says not to estimate when an input is missing, so I have not chosen a country, averaged the values, or used the highest or lowest.

## Needed to proceed

Please specify the **country of production**. For CN 7201, the table lists:

| Country | Default SEE (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|
| Türkiye | 1.85 |
| China | 1.66 |
| India | 2.53 |

Once the country is confirmed, the calculation will be:

**Embedded emissions = SEE (CN 7201, country) × 1,000 t**, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.

If the country of production is not one of these three, the table has no default value for it, and the emissions cannot be computed under this ruleset.
